label: Cabin Intrusion Alarm
info: Door-triggered intrusion detection gated by manual Arm Away and person.natecabin presence. Live siren MQTT outputs are intentionally disabled until dry-run validation is complete.

name: Remember armed state
Remember Nate presence
Closed → open only
Require armed + Nate away
Build siren ON messages
func:
const devices = ['leak_alarm_fridge','leak_alarm_bathroom','leak_alarm_dishwasher'];
return [devices.map(device => ({...msg, topic:`zigbee2mqtt/${device}/set`, payload:JSON.stringify({state:'ON'}), qos:1, retain:false}))];

name: Build siren OFF messages
func:
const devices = ['leak_alarm_fridge','leak_alarm_bathroom','leak_alarm_dishwasher'];
return [devices.map(device => ({topic:`zigbee2mqtt/${device}/set`, payload:JSON.stringify({state:'OFF'}), qos:1, retain:false}))];
